about: Life, not money (all "life": true, so they take some of the money cards’ places: MONEYW in js/engine.js). People reaching out, whom you can answer or ignore until you drift apart (js/people.js: canCall, callOk, talk, ignore, mend); festivals in each country; making peace.

en..x: {P} calls. It’s been a while, and this is a busy week.
en..long.s: The evening you’d planned is gone. Happiness −1.
en..later.s: A shorter call, a few days later.
en..ring.h: Ignore someone often enough and they stop calling.

zh..x: {P}打来电话。你们有一阵子没好好聊了，而这周正忙。
zh..long.s: 原本的安排泡汤了。幸福感 −1。

zht..no.s: 你轉而熬夜複習到半夜。

en..x: At the corner shop {n} slips a chocolate bar into their pocket and grins at you.
en..say.s: You say it quietly, but you say it.
en..quiet: Say nothing, and never mention it
en..leave: Walk out and go home alone
en..leave.s: You don’t want any part of it.

zh..x: 在街角小店里，{n}把一块巧克力塞进口袋，冲你咧嘴一笑。
zh..say.s: 你说得很小声，但你说了。
zh..quiet: 什么也不说，以后也不提
zh..leave: 转身走出去，一个人回家

zht..x: 在街角小店裡，{n}把一塊巧克力塞進口袋，對你咧嘴一笑。
zht..say.s: 你說得很小聲，但你說了。
zht..quiet: 什麼也不說，以後也不提
zht..leave: 轉身走出去，一個人回家

en..x: A rumour about a classmate is going round, and everyone is laughing. You know it isn’t true.
en..stand: Say out loud that it isn’t true
en..stand.s: The laughing stops, and some of it turns to you.
en..quiet: Tell the classmate you don’t believe it

zh..x: 关于一个同学的谣言传开了，大家都在笑。你知道那不是真的。
zh..stand.s: 笑声停了，有些笑声转向了你。
zh..quiet: 私下告诉那位同学你不相信

zht..x: 關於一個同學的謠言傳開了，大家都在笑。你知道那不是真的。
zht..stand.s: 笑聲停了，有些笑聲轉向了你。
zht..quiet: 私下告訴那位同學你不相信

en..x: A coworker’s mistake has cost the team a client. Your boss asks who did it. Your coworker looks at you.
en..truth.s: Your coworker won’t look at you for weeks.
en..quiet.s: The question hangs in the air, then passes.

zh..x: 同事的失误让团队丢了一个客户。上司问是谁做的。那位同事看着你。
zh..truth.s: 那位同事好几个星期都不看你。
zh..quiet.s: 问题悬在半空，然后过去了。
zh..share: 替对方担下一部分责任

zht..x: 同事的失誤讓團隊丟了一個客戶。主管問是誰做的。那位同事看著你。
zht..truth.s: 那位同事好幾個星期都不看你。
zht..quiet.s: 問題懸在半空，然後過去了。
zht..share: 替對方擔下一部分責任

en..x: {P} wants to quit and open a café, and asks what you really think. You think it will struggle.
en..honest.s: A long silence on the other end.
en..back.s: “If anyone can do it, you can.”
en..ask.s: You let them find the answer themselves.

zh..x: {P}想辞职开一家咖啡馆，问你真心怎么看。你觉得会很难撑下去。
zh..back.s: “要是有谁能做到，那一定是你。”

zht..x: {P}想辭職開一家咖啡館，問你真心怎麼看。你覺得會很難撐下去。
zht..back.s: 「要是有誰能做到，那一定是你。」

en..x: Months ago you promised {p} you’d help paint their new flat this weekend. Now a friend offers you a spare ticket to something you’ve waited years to see, on the same day.
en..keep.s: Paint in your hair, and the ticket goes to someone else.
en..explain: Explain, and go to the show

zh..x: 几个月前，你答应{p}这个周末去帮忙粉刷新家。现在朋友多出一张票，正是你等了好多年想看的，偏偏在同一天。
zh..keep.s: 头发上沾了油漆，票给了别人。

zht..x: 幾個月前，你答應{p}這個週末去幫忙粉刷新家。現在朋友多出一張票，正是你等了好多年想看的，偏偏在同一天。
zht..keep.s: 頭髮上沾了油漆，票給了別人。

en..x: In a meeting, your boss mocks a junior colleague’s accent. A few people laugh. The colleague goes quiet.
en..after.s: “That wasn’t OK. Are you all right?”
en..report.s: You write down exactly what was said.
en..let.s: It’s just how the boss is.

zh..x: 会议上，上司拿一位年轻同事的口音开玩笑。有几个人笑了。那位同事不说话了。
zh..now.s: 会议室一下子安静下来。
zh..report.s: 你把原话一字一句记下来。

zht..x: 會議上，主管拿一位年輕同事的口音開玩笑。有幾個人笑了。那位同事不說話了。
zht..now.s: 會議室一下子安靜下來。
zht..report.s: 你把原話一字一句記下來。

en..x: On the train you find a bag with a laptop, a diary and a name tag. Your stop is next.
en..track.s: An evening of emails and phone calls.
en..desk: Hand it to the station staff
en..leave.s: Someone else will hand it in.

zh..x: 你在火车上发现一个包，里面有笔记本电脑、一本日记和一张名牌。下一站就是你要下的站。
zh..track.s: 一个晚上都在发邮件、打电话。

zht..x: 你在火車上發現一個包，裡面有筆電、一本日記和一張名牌。下一站就是你要下的站。
zht..track.s: 一個晚上都在寄信、打電話。

en..x: {P} has lost their job and hasn’t told your parents. Today your parents ask you straight out if something is wrong.
en..urge: Buy time, and push {n} to tell them

zh..x: {P}丢了工作，还没告诉爸妈。今天爸妈直接问你是不是出了什么事。

zht..x: {P}丟了工作，還沒告訴爸媽。今天爸媽直接問你是不是出了什麼事。

en..x: A colleague who often let the team down asks you for a reference. They need this job; they have a family to support.
en..fair: Write a fair one, good and bad
en..decline: Tell them, kindly, that you can’t

zh..x: 一位常常拖累团队的同事请你写推荐信。对方很需要这份工作，家里还要养。
zh..glow.s: 每个人都该有第二次机会。
zh..decline.s: 一杯咖啡，一场艰难的谈话。

zht..x: 一位常常拖累團隊的同事請你寫推薦信。對方很需要這份工作，家裡還要養。
zht..glow.s: 每個人都該有第二次機會。
zht..decline.s: 一杯咖啡，一場艱難的談話。

en..x: At a big meeting, {p} presents your idea as their own. Everyone is impressed.

zh..x: 在一场重要会议上，{p}把你的点子当成自己的提了出来。大家都很佩服。

zht..x: 在一場重要會議上，{p}把你的點子當成自己的提了出來。大家都很佩服。

en..x: {P} asks what you really think of the person they’re planning to marry. You have doubts.
en..support.s: You keep the doubts to yourself.
en..life: “It’s your life, and I’ll be there either way”
en..life.s: You give them the question back.

zh..x: {P}问你，对自己打算结婚的那个人真心怎么看。你心里有些疑虑。
zh..life: “这是你的人生，无论怎样我都在”

zht..x: {P}問你，對自己打算結婚的那個人真心怎麼看。你心裡有些疑慮。
zht..life: 「這是你的人生，無論怎樣我都在」

en..x: Decades ago you let {n} take the blame for something you did. They have never mentioned it.
en..rest.s: Some things are better left alone.
en..make: Say nothing, but be a better friend

zh..x: 几十年前，你让{n}替你背了一次黑锅。对方从来没提过。
zh..make: 不说，但做个更好的朋友

zht..x: 幾十年前，你讓{n}替你背了一次黑鍋。對方從來沒提過。
zht..make: 不說，但做個更好的朋友

en..x: On a late bus, someone keeps pestering a young passenger, who looks frightened. Nobody does anything.
en..step: Tell them to leave the passenger alone
en..step.s: Your voice is louder than you expected.
en..sit: Sit next to the passenger and chat, as if you were old friends
en..sit.s: “There you are! How was your day?”

zh..x: 深夜的公交车上，有人一直纠缠一位年轻乘客，对方看起来很害怕。没有人出声。
zh..step.s: 你的声音比你以为的还大。
zh..sit: 坐到那位乘客旁边，装作老朋友聊起天来
zh..sit.s: “原来你在这儿！今天过得怎样？”

zht..x: 深夜的公車上，有人一直糾纏一位年輕乘客，對方看起來很害怕。沒有人出聲。
zht..step.s: 你的聲音比你以為的還大。
zht..sit: 坐到那位乘客旁邊，裝作老朋友聊起天來
zht..sit.s: 「原來你在這裡！今天過得怎樣？」
